description: This vertical grouped bar chart illustrates the performance scores of three different models across four benchmark datasets. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Benchmark," and presents four datasets ordered from left to right: MathVista, MathVerse, MMMU-Pro, and Physics. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Score," utilizing a linear scale that ranges from 35 to 80 with numerical tick labels at regular intervals of 5. For each benchmark, the chart displays a group of three adjacent vertical bars, whose arrangement is defined by a legend in the upper right. The legend pairs model names with distinct colors: SRPO-7B in dark blue, GRPO-7B in medium blue, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B in light blue. Within every benchmark category, the bars are arranged from left to right following this exact color sequence, and each bar is visually emphasized by having its exact numerical score annotated directly above it. A consistent visual trend is present within each group, where the dark blue bar is always the tallest, followed by the medium blue bar, and the light blue bar is the shortest, creating a descending staircase effect. The tallest individual bar on the chart belongs to SRPO-7B in the MathVista category with a score of 75.8, accompanied by GRPO-7B at 72.3 and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B at 68.2. Conversely, the shortest bar on the chart is Qwen-2.5-VL-7B in the MMMU-Pro category at 36.9, within a group that also scores 42.3 and 39.9. The remaining groups display respective scores of 55.8, 52.9, and 46.3 for MathVerse, and 60.6, 53.5, and 45.4 for Physics. The categories along the horizontal axis do not follow a strict alphabetical or global ascending/descending sorting order, and dashed light gray horizontal and vertical gridlines provide a visual reference across the plotting area.
